results.rationale: The red fire engine, yellow stripes, white shutters, roof cannon and gray backdrop retain their identity, with a small change in mirror detailing. The view turns somewhat toward the side but remains a strong front three-quarter view, unlike the reference's perpendicular side profile; the front grille and windshield are still prominently visible. The edited vehicle has coherent geometry, wheels and metallic surfaces.

The river course, fields and sky remain recognizable, but forest textures are redrawn and a second small boat and pale oval artifact appear near the bank. The main boat is Chinese-styled, yet has a tall pavilion cabin instead of the explained low black-canopied Wu-peng form. The required boat type is only partially achieved. Its hull and reflection are readable, but an unsupported pale oval beside it and awkward cabin details are noticeable flaws.
